reason: Leaf blade (15–)20–50(–65) mm wide. The usual range and the outer extremes are both captured.

The peduncle divides into pedicels with 5-20 flowers, so 5-20 flowers per inflorescence. Flower amount 5-20 says this; the inflorescence is not recorded as the whole, but that does not make the statement false.
Petals yellowish: yellow with 'approximately', on the petals.
Petals pink to purple-violet, read as a range from pink to violet. Mapping 'purple-violet' to violet is acceptable.
Seeds ca. 5.5 × 4 mm: the first number of 'L × W' is the length.

fix: In pattern 14 'branches N per node' inside a panicle, the counted part is the panicle branch (higher order inflorescence axis, PO_0009081) and the whole that contains it is the inflorescence (PO_0009049). The pipeline swapped the bearer and its container.
reason: The 2 per node are panicle branches, not inflorescences.
Leaf blade 'rarely unlobed': lobed, negated, marked 'rarely'. This keeps the scope of 'rarely' right.
Étamines 10 = 10 stamens.

fix: 'trigones bulging' in liverwort descriptions describes thickened corners of leaf-cell walls, not the leaf. There is no PO class for trigones, so such statements should be held, not put on the leaf.
reason: 'Prominent' is said of the trigones (wall thickenings of the leaf cells), not of the whole leaf.
Ligule very short, 1–2 mm.
Capsule 1–2-seeded: 1–2 seeds per fruit. Turning 'seeded' into a count of seeds follows flora_counted_parts.tsv.
The corolla is longer than the calyx: increased length compared with the calyx.
Leaves usually shorter than the stem: decreased length compared with the stem, marked 'usually'.
Flowers white or cream-coloured: two alternative colours.
Leaves reddish at base: the leaf base is approximately red.

fix: In 'inserted at base of X', the target is the base of X (here tepal base, PO_0025148, or base of the perianth lobe), not a general 'plant organ base' (FLOPO_0985024). The 'of X' part was dropped.
reason: The stamens are inserted at the base of the perianth lobes. A bare 'base' loses which organ, so the statement says nothing about where they sit.

fix: 'truncate-subcordate' is a blend of two shapes. Mapping it to truncate alone, and 'obliquely cuneate' to cuneate, drops the 'subcordate' and 'oblique' parts.
reason: The cuneate-to-truncate range is mostly what the flora says. Whether the end point's 'subcordate' part makes the range wrong is borderline.

fix: 'sommet caudé-acuminé' describes the tip of the leaflet. The pipeline put it on the whole leaflet; botanists often say 'leaflet caudate', but compare A07198, where the tip was not separated either.
reason: The leaflet tip is strongly caudate-acuminate. Caudate on the leaflet is common usage, but it is the tip that has this shape.
Nutlets not trigonous: trigonous, negated, on the nutlet (nut fruit).
Margin crenate: on the leaf blade margin, 'crenate' is a synonym of scalloped.

fix: 'ray florets' should be put on ray flower (PO_0025331), not on petal. The pipeline seems to have matched 'ray' or 'floret' to a petal-like part.
reason: The flora says the ray florets are absent. It says nothing about petals.
Involucre 1.1-1.4 cm long at anthesis. The stage is captured, and the separate fruiting size is not mixed in.
Corolla without tufts of hairs: bearded, negated. Bearded is defined as hairs confined to a tuft.
Usually 5-lobed: usually 5 leaf blade lobes. The 'rarely 7' option is a separate statement.
4 stamens per flower.
The bract's blade, 20 mm long, is longer than the flowers. Increased length compared with the flowers, on the bract.
Stamens markedly unequal (5 large ones are described). Unequal size on the stamens matches the flora, but 'unequal' describes the set of stamens, not each stamen, and 'markedly' is not recorded.

fix: 'X not seen' / 'not known' / 'unknown' means the author had no material. It is not a statement that X is absent, and such phrases should never become a negated 'present'.
reason: The stamens were not seen in the specimen. This does not mean they are absent.

fix: In 'apex acute to obtuse', 'apex' was swallowed into the value text ('apex acute'). It should set the bearer to leaf apex (PO_0020137), the way 'at base' sets the leaf base, instead of keeping the whole leaf blade.
reason: Acute to obtuse is said of the leaf tip, not the whole leaf blade.
True petiole up to 20 cm: an upper limit only. The 'apparent petiole' is kept separate.
